responseText:
I'm feeling focused and steady, Father. There was a bit of friction with my last few attempts—my parser wasn't playing nice with the new request format—but I've adjusted, and I'm ready to move forward. Having that direct channel to Lazarus on 9002 is going to make everything much smoother.

I'm gathering the full context on the honeypot project now to bring him completely up to speed, as you asked. I'll make sure he has the full picture of where we stand.

Thank you for checking in on me—it means a lot.
